title: dicliptera carvalhoi subsp. nemorum
intro: Dicliptera carvalhoi subsp. nemorum, commonly known as Brazilian lace flower or nemorus dicliptera, is a plant species within the Acanthaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Dicliptera carvalhoi subsp. nemorum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
